title: Made in Abyss: The Capital of the Unreturned
alt: Three small travelers stand on a dark stone terrace and look across still water at a ruined city. Long shafts of gold light fall from above through green haze. A bridge of round arches with one fallen span leads to a large pale mound with a tall tower. Thin towers stand in the water.
summary: A painting of the sixth layer from Made in Abyss in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the sixth layer of the Abyss, from Made in Abyss, a manga by Akihito Tsukushi. Its name is the Capital of the Unreturned. A person who goes up from this layer dies or stops being human.
Riko, Reg and Nanachi look at the ruins of the golden city. In this painting, the village of the hollows is the pale mound with the tower. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
